newsitem.title: USA: Nike stock down despite record results.
newsitem.headline: Nike stock down despite record results.

text.p: The stock of sports shoe and apparel maker Nike Inc. opened lower Wednesday as investors reacted to its lower-than-expected earnings for the latest quarter.
Nike lost $2.8125 to trade at $56 early on the New York Stock Exchange. The stock peaked at more than $76 in February.
The company said late Tuesday that it earned $155.8 million, or 52 cents a share, for the three months ended May 31, up 17 percent from $133.7 million, or 45 cents a share, in the year-ago period.
Revenues rose 28 percent to $2.37 billion from $1.85 billion.
The results were at the low end of the prediction Nike issued May 29, which sent its stock tumbling and spurred Wall Street analysts to cut their earnings forecasts.
Nike sold a record $9.19 billion worth of sneakers, T-shirts and other sports gear in its latest fiscal year, up 42 percent from the $6.47 billion in sales a year earlier.
Nike said its earnings rose 44 percent in the fiscal year to $796 million, or $2.68 a share, compared with $553 million, or $1.88 a share, a year earlier.
In a conference call late Tuesday, Nike executives said the company was on track to meet its long-term goal of sales and earnings growth of 15 percent to 18 percent a year.
